prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Official Adoption Ceremony", "Welcome your new companion into your digital home with an official signing ceremony.", "Name your companion"]
1: ["Begin Your Pet Companion Journey", "Scroll to explore custom creations or adoption paths tailored to your desktop experience.", "Select your journey path"]
2: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Let us quickly review how to interact with your pet on your screen.", "How to Interact with Your Pet", "Right-click your pet on the desktop to talk, feed, or hide them at any time.", "Got it!"]
3: ["Save Your New Companion", "Sign in now to sync your chosen companion to the cloud and ensure they are never lost."]
4: ["Your Companion is Hatching...", "Listen to gentle ambient sounds while your desktop pet is prepared for arrival.", "Preparing desktop environment"]
5: ["Official Digital Pet Adoption Certificate", "Complete adoption to receive your verified digital ownership crest.", "Verified Desktop Companion Crest"]
6: ["Sign In to Your Pet Account", "Sign in with your existing account to recover existing pets and prevent account resets.", "Looking for a previously adopted pet? Make sure to use your original sign-in provider."]
7: ["Meet Your Next Desktop Companion", "Explore available pets in full visual resolution."]
8: ["Preparing Companion Desktop Display", "Ensure your desktop is visible. Your pet will spawn directly on your main monitor once loading finishes."]
9: ["Pet Behavior & Interaction Setup", "Choose how active and vocal you want your pet to be on your desktop.", "Enable desktop sound effects", "Save Preferences"]
